data:text/html,<body><canvas id="mainCanvas"></canvas><style>html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;width:100%25;height:100%25;background:black;font-family:sans-serif}canvas{display:block}</style><script>const t=document.getElementById("mainCanvas"),e=t.getContext("2d"),i=window.innerWidth,n=window.innerHeight,a=i/100,h=n/5;let l=n/2-h/2,o=l,M=i/2,d=n/2,r=2*Math.random()*Math.PI;function m(t,e,i,n){return!(t-5>i+a||i>t+5||e-5>n+h||n>e+5)}function s(){M=i/2,d=n/2,r=2*Math.random()*Math.PI,l=n/2-h/2,o=l}t.width=i,t.height=n,window.requestAnimationFrame(function t(){e.fillStyle="black",e.fillRect(0,0,i,n),d<o+h/3?(o-=2,o=Math.max(0,o)):d>o+2*h/3&&(o+=2,o=Math.min(n-h,o));let c=3*Math.cos(r),f=3*Math.sin(r);if(M+=c,d-=f,d<=5&&(d=Math.abs(d),r=2*Math.PI-r),d>=n-5&&(d=Math.abs(d),r=2*Math.PI-r),m(M,d,2*a,l)){M=3*a+5;let t=(d-(l+h/2))/(h/2+5);r=2*Math.PI+Math.PI/3*-t}if(m(M,d,i-3*a,o)){M=i-3*a-5;let t=(d-(o+h/2))/(h/2+5);r=3*Math.PI+Math.PI/3*t}M<-10&&s(),M>i+10&&s(),e.fillStyle="white",e.fillRect(2*a,l,a,h),e.fillRect(i-3*a,o,a,h),e.fillRect(M-5,d-5,10,10),e.lineWidth=2,e.lineCap="round",e.strokeStyle="white",e.setLineDash([1,5]),e.beginPath(),e.moveTo(i/2,0),e.lineTo(i/2,n),e.stroke(),window.requestAnimationFrame(t)});</script></body>
